title: RoamiOS
description: I built RoamiOS because WanderingBong outgrew every CMS I put it on. The agent works the queue and hands me drafts. I write and publish.
lede: I built RoamiOS because WanderingBong outgrew every CMS I put it on.
story:
After each post I was still doing the admin: tags, internal links, cover images, meta descriptions, and a pass through Search Console to decide what to write next.

Today WanderingBong runs on it. My agent connects over MCP and works the queue: missing covers, thin metadata, untold trips, queries sitting just off page one. It hands me drafts to review. I write and publish. The agent cannot publish. That gate lives in the API, not in a setting I might forget to flip.

The screens above are WanderingBong on 31 October 2026. Search Console for the prior 28 days is in the shots as captured, including clicks down about 31 percent and a site health of 69.

roami.xyz is the product site. app.roami.xyz is the desk.
